zh.name: VIVIAN WANG
zh.role: 化妆总监 | VIVIAN ADVENTURE 创始人
zh.bio:
资深影视与时尚，专注中英及国际项目：
• 英国电影电视剧造型总监
• 加拿大电影服化道总执行
• 尚美巴黎（Chaumet）高珠晚宴、时装周秀场及明星红毯特邀合作造型总监
• 服务领域：电影制作、短剧、综艺、广告、时尚、婚礼定制、高端定制、明星同款旅拍

en.name: Vivian Wang
en.role: Makeup Director | Founder of VIVIAN ADVENTURE
en.bio:
Experienced in film and fashion across UK–China projects:
• Styling Director (UK film & TV)
• Executive Head of Costume & Makeup (Canadian films)
• Invited lead for Chaumet high jewelry gala, fashion weeks & red carpet
• Services: film, short dramas, variety, commercials, fashion, wedding couture, bespoke destination shoots

zh.name: Hao
zh.bio:
专注时尚与艺人肖像光影塑造，注重高级质感与可传播视觉。
风格：稳健光比、克制修饰、定制化方案。
领域：时尚拍摄、形象升级、品牌与艺人肖像。

en.name: Hao
en.bio:
Focuses on fashion & artist portrait light shaping with a refined, shareable finish.
Style: controlled ratios, restrained retouch, tailored planning.
Domains: fashion shoots, image refinement, brand & artist portraits.

zh.name: Jade
zh.bio:
电影与时尚影像创作，擅长情绪光影与人物表达。
特点：叙事张力、镜头节奏感、技术与美学平衡。

en.name: Jade
en.bio:
Film & fashion visual creator; strong at mood lighting and character expression.
Traits: narrative tension, rhythmic framing, balance of craft and aesthetics.

zh.name: Lori
zh.role: 化妆师｜造型与发型设计
zh.bio:
重视妆容与发型结构统一，强化整体线条与光泽层次。
擅长：婚礼精致造型、快速换造、饰品与发型融合。
风格：干净、不过度堆砌、轻留白。

en.name: Lori
en.bio:
Aligns makeup and hair structure for cohesive silhouettes and soft sheen.
Strengths: refined bridal looks, efficient restyling, accessory integration.
Style: clean, minimal excess, subtle negative space.

zh.name: Johnny
zh.bio:
聚焦男士气质与发型流向，结合骨骼与发量做自然过渡。
擅长：商务形象、人像清爽定型、快速现场调整。
风格：自然纹理、低饱和、细节收尾。

en.name: Johnny
en.bio:
Focuses on men's grooming with natural flow aligned to structure.
Strengths: business polish, clean portrait setting, fast event adjustments.
Style: natural texture, restrained palette, neat finish.

zh.name: Ivy
zh.role: 摄影与妆造助理｜客户与档期协调
zh.bio:
负责客户沟通、物料清单与档期协调，现场支持灯光与基础补妆。
特点：节奏与细节跟进、跨组联络、快速响应。

en.name: Ivy
en.role: Photo & Styling Assistant | Client & Scheduling Coordinator
en.bio:
Manages client updates, asset lists and scheduling; supports lighting and minor touch‑ups on set.
Traits: pace tracking, cross‑team liaison, responsive support.

zh.name: Patrick Xue
zh.role: 摄影师｜影像艺术创作者
zh.bio:
结合传统与实验媒介，探索材质与情绪的影像表达。
擅长：胶片/即时成像、叙事型 MV、材质肌理营造。

en.name: Patrick Xue
en.bio:
Blends traditional and experimental media to explore texture and mood.
Strengths: film & instant formats, narrative MV, material tactility.

zh.name: Kris
zh.bio:
以富士色彩与自然光构建富有呼吸感的人像氛围。
擅长：自然街拍、克制细节、色温渐变。

en.name: Kris
en.bio:
Uses Fujifilm color and natural light for airy, restrained portraits.
Strengths: candid urban sessions, subtle detail, gentle temperature shifts.

zh.name: Fu
zh.bio:
专注色彩与情绪的平衡，构建带时间质感的光影。
特点：留白控制、光影层次、真实情绪捕捉。

en.name: Fu
en.bio:
Balances color and emotion, shaping time‑layered light.
Traits: managed negative space, layered illumination, authentic mood capture.
